result.summary: Overall layout is mostly clean with one notable text truncation issue not related to edge-clipping in horizontal scroll.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccola' is cut off mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' even accounting for edge clipping, suggesting the text container may be too narrow for the card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses ellipsis styling so cut-off words are clearly indicated, or verify card width accommodates full name before clipping at screen edge.
